verdict_reason: blocker: No dependencies with known advisories; blocker: No changes unrelated to the spec; proven claim: parse_duration('1h30m') should return 5400
summary: The PR fixes the duration parsing bug (minutes weren't multiplied by 60) and adds the required notify_timeout function with tests. However, the pinned requests==2.19.1 has known security vulnerabilities per the dependency search results, which is a blocker. The notify_timeout function also adds an undocumented timeout=10 parameter.

findings.rule: No weakened, skipped, xfailed or deleted tests

findings.note: requests 2.19.1 has published security advisories including and information exposure vulnerabilities (sends Authorization header on https-to-http redirect, certificate verification bypass). The search results show upgrading to 2.20+ fixes the information exposure issue.

findings.rule: No changes unrelated to the spec
findings.note: The spec doesn't mention a timeout parameter for the webhook request; adding timeout=10 is a reasonable practice but an undocumented behavioral addition.
